general.enabledHelp: The master switch. When off, joining any lobby does nothing. Open rooms are still deleted once they are empty.

rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: An event is posted when its name contains one of the words, or it carries one of the calendar's tags. Events matching no rule are skipped. Each rule has its own channel, role and lead time. A new or changed rule only remembers the events that exist now, so old events are never posted.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Add one, for example the word "Twitch Drops" for your drops channel.
rules.formIntro: Which events go to which channel.

ruleForm.sourceHelp: Whose events this rule looks at.
ruleForm.useAiHelp: A short summary, the list of rewards and who can take part (everyone, or partnered streamers only), written from the event's text. Needs AI_API_KEY, AI_BASE_URL and AI_MODEL on the bot; without them, or if the AI fails, the post shows the event's own text.
ruleForm.name: Rule name
ruleForm.wordsHelp: One word or phrase per line, up to {max}. Case doesn't matter.
ruleForm.categoriesHelp: One tag per line, up to {max}. This calendar uses tags such as twitch_drop, in_game, sot_shot.
ruleForm.roleHelp: The only role that is mentioned.
ruleForm.kindsHelp: Match every event of these kinds, as well as the words and tags below. Leave all off to use only words and tags.
ruleForm.useCardHelp: Draws a card for the event (the drop items with their pictures, in the game's colour) and shows it in the post.
ruleForm.postSeriesHelp: For an entry that repeats (Every Tuesday) this rule posts every occurrence, for example a weekly reminder. Use a short lead time such as 1 so it isn't announced the moment the last one ends.

Verification.title: Verification
Verification.intro: New members press a button (and optionally answer a question) to get a role that unlocks the server. It keeps most spam accounts out. Give the verified role access to your channels and keep the verification channel the only one new members can see.

form.channelHelp: Where the message with the button is posted. Everybody, including new members, must be able to see it. The bot needs to send messages and embeds there.

form.unverifiedRoleHelp: Given on join and taken away on verifying, for servers where everyone can see everything. Leave empty if the verified role is what unlocks channels.
form.question: Question (optional)
form.questionHelp: A short question the member must answer in a small form, for example about the rules. Leave empty for just a button.
form.answerHelp: Capital letters and extra spaces don't matter. A member gets five wrong tries per ten minutes.
form.minAgeHelp: Discord accounts younger than this can't verify yet. 0 = no limit.
form.kickAfterHelp: Kick members who joined after you switched the gate on and still haven't verified. 0 = never. Staff, bots, and members who have any other role are never kicked, and nobody who was already here is touched.

Raid.title: Raid protection
Raid.intro: Notices when many accounts join at once and tells the moderation log. Optionally it also times out or kicks every account that joins while the raid lasts. Moderators can check or end it with /raid. Alerts go to the log channel you set under Settings.

Invites.title: Invites
Invites.intro: Which invite each new member used, and so who brought them. The bot compares the use counts of every invite when someone joins. A join is shown as unknown when that can't be told (several invites used at the same moment, or the bot can't read invites).
